name: Uchi wa Mou, Enki Dekinai.
original_name: ウチはもう、延期できない。
source:
Spring break. Miyamura Miku, a hobby writer of light novels, is approached by her older sister Miyamura Karin, who reveals to her that she's working as a voice actress for erotic games.

"The company I am working for right now needs someone to assist with writing the sex scenes!" Karin asks for Miku's assistance. 

"Wait, I'm still a virgin, you know? I have no clue how to write such a thing!"

At the same time the protagonist, Shiiba Masashi, is getting a sudden call from his big sister.

"Jeez, we can't! We're delaying. Can't. Impossible. We delay."

The one who keeps repeating these phrases like a broken record, is the protagonist's older sister, Shiiba Sayaka - CEO as well as scenario writer of the popular upstart eroge brand "Hades Soft".

"If we delay now, then we're done for. The sponsors will be chasing us for the rest of our life in order to reclaim the cash. We have to find a solution or I'll be to the neck in debt! I'll come haunt you if this kills me, okay?!"

And so, Masashi ends up being roped into helping them with their eroge development?!

This game is centering around eccentric heroines like the artist Suzumoto Chisa (pen name: Suzuse Akiko) and the reclusive colorist Sakakibara Ai. Here comes an ADV about creating eroge that's a little on the weirder side.

IF YOU LOVE EROGE, DON'T JOIN AN EROGE COMPANY!

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/enking/]Official website[/url]]
translation:
春假。宫村未来是一位爱好轻小说的作家，她的姐姐宫村花琳找到了她，并向她透露自己正在为色情游戏担任配音演员。

“我现在工作的公司需要有人帮忙写性爱场面！”卡琳请求未来的帮助。

“等等，我还是处女，你知道吗？我不知道如何写这样的东西！”

与此同时，主角椎叶正志突然接到了姐姐的电话。

“天哪，我们不能！我们在拖延。不能。不可能。我们在拖延。”

像破唱片一样不断重复这句话的，是主角的姐姐椎叶早香，她是人气工口游戏新贵品牌“Hades Soft”的首席执行官兼剧本作家。

“如果我们现在再拖延，那我们就完蛋了。赞助商会追着我们一辈子，只为了收回现金。我们必须找到解决办法，否则我会负债累累！如果这杀了我，我会来缠着你，好吗？！”

所以，正志最终被拉去帮助他们开发工口游戏？！

这款游戏以艺术家铃本千纱（笔名：铃濑晶子）和隐居的调色师榊原爱等古怪的女主角为中心。这是一个关于创造工口游戏的ADV，有点奇怪。

如果你喜欢EROGE，请不要加入EROGE公司！
